answer: A small stake of lotus tokens is locked per identity and slashed if collusion is detected, while a rotating zephyr committee audits registrations for duplicate fingerprints, raising attacker cost beyond any profit from fake accounts. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent identity must solve a unique, verifiable puzzle whose difficulty follows a spiral schedule, so forging N identities costs N times the compute and energy of one honest join. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
